summary: Publish 0.1.1 so hosts on 0.1.0+vlan1 see an available update; Available always shows the repo version.

guide.reason: Operator steps unchanged; only package version ordering and Available field display.

api.reason: Update routes and schemas unchanged; published package version and UI display only.

state.reason: Software-update behaviour only: the repository location and signing key live in host-local package configuration (/etc/nex/updates.conf, APT sources) owned by the package, not a pool setting, and the Controller stores nothing.

verification.method: dpkg --compare-versions 0.1.0+vlan1 lt 0.1.1 succeeds; go test ./internal/nexupdate -run TestCompareVersions; https://nexvirtualization.com/apt/updates.json lists 0.1.1.
